2608.05891.title: AppDeltaWorld: Transition-Grounded Delta Code World Model for Mobile GUI Agents
2608.05891.paper_summary: Mobile GUI agents can operate apps through pixel perception and touch actions, making them a promising interface for collecting and improving long-horizon mobile interaction policies. However, real trajectories are difficult to obtain for sensitive apps and privacy-critical operations. At the same time, existing simulated environments are costly to scale up, and GUI world models still suffer from unstable generation, limited modality coverage, and inconsistent action-transition logic. To address these limitations, we propose AppDeltaWorld, a transition-grounded delta code world model that predicts the next GUI as a reachable code update rather than as an unconstrained image or text description. AppDeltaWorld retrieves app-specific Level-1 HTML references under an action-transition constraint, generates Level-2 executable HTML conditioned on the current screen, action, predicted next-screen text, and retrieved structure, and inserts generated visual assets into image slots before browser rendering. As a world model, AppDeltaWorld achieves the highest fidelity on CMGUIBench-500 under Code2World evaluation, with clear gains in structural layout and UI element reconstruction over image-only and code-only baselines. As a training environment, AppDeltaWorld supports filtered closed-loop SFT data construction that, when combined with public supervision, enables AppDeltaAgent to achieve state-of-the-art performance on AndroidLens and consistent gains on MobileGym and MobileWorld. Moreover, world-model-based test-time reinforcement learning enables policy adaptation and shows further improvements without additional interaction with real apps.
2608.05891.paper_summary_zh: 行動 GUI 代理可以通過像素感知和觸控操作來操作應用程式，使其成為收集和改善長期行動互動政策的有前景介面。<lb/>然而，對於敏感應用程式和隱私關鍵操作，實際軌跡難以獲得。<lb/>同時，現有的模擬環境在擴展方面成本高昂，且 GUI 世界模型仍然面臨不穩定的生成、有限的模態覆蓋以及不一致的動作轉換邏輯等問題。<lb/>為了解決這些限制，我們提出了 AppDeltaWorld，一種基於轉換的增量代碼世界模型，它將下一個 GUI 預測為可達的代碼更新，而不是不受限制的圖像或文本描述。<lb/>AppDeltaWorld 在動作轉換約束下檢索應用特定的 Level-1 HTML 參考，根據當前螢幕、動作、預測的下一螢幕文本和檢索的結構生成 Level-2 可執行 HTML，並在瀏覽器渲染之前將生成的視覺資產插入圖像槽中。<lb/>作為一個世界模型，AppDeltaWorld 在 Code2World 評估中在 CMGUIBench-500 上實現了最高的真實度，並在結構佈局和 UI 元素重建方面相較於僅圖像和僅代碼基準有明顯提升。<lb/>作為訓練環境，AppDeltaWorld 支持過濾的閉環 SFT 數據構建，當與公共監督結合時，使 AppDeltaAgent 在 AndroidLens 上實現了最先進的性能，並在 MobileGym 和 MobileWorld 上持續獲得提升。<lb/>此外，基於世界模型的測試時增強學習使政策適應成為可能，並在不與實際應用程式進行額外互動的情況下顯示出進一步的改善。
